children: The U.S. State Department said on Tuesday it has committed over $150 million in U.S. support for Pacific Islands.

Working with the U.S. Congress, the department said it intends to provide $60 million to help Pacific Islands countries address the global energy crisis, including expanding fuel storage capacity and supporting grid stability.
